[SWS_DM_01226] Support of UDS service authentication
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04251
⌈
If configured, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall provide the UDS service
0x29 Authentication with the subfunctions.
0x00
deAuthenticate
0x01
verifyCertificateUnidirectional
0x02
verifyCertificateBidirectional
0x03
proofOfOwnership
0x04
transmitCertificate
0x08
authenticationConfiguration
according to ISO 14229-1:2020 [1].
⌋
Note: The Diagnostic Manager only implements the authentication via PKI certificate
exchange. Authentication with challenge-response (ACR) is currently out of scope of
the Diagnostic Manager.
